newsitem.title: USA: Guidant, Hewlett-Packard agree to develop catheter.
newsitem.headline: Guidant, Hewlett-Packard agree to develop catheter.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Tuesday it has signed a joint agreement with Hewlett-Packard Co to develop and market a high-frequency intravascular ultrasound (IVUS) diagnostic catheter.
IVUS provides a live view of the inner artery, therefore making it easier to identify treatment options during cardiology procedures, Guidant said.

Under the agreement, Hewlett-Packard will develop the IVUS imaging core and Guidant will act as the original equipment manufacturer of the catheter. Guidant will market and sell the product worldwidem, the company said.
The catheter is a new high-frequency system, which will result in superior image quality, Guidant said.
Guidant and Hewlett-Packard previously entered into agreements related to Guidant's coronary angioplasty catheter and distribution of IVUS catheters, the company said.
